latest_interim.note: Q3-26 revenue $1,089.7m +6.2%; organic 4.4%, acquisitions 1.8%. Organic residential 2.3%, commercial 6.6%, termite & ancillary 5.3%. 9M-26: revenue +8.0%, organic 5.5%, acquisitions 2.5% (residential organic 3.3%). Operating margin 20.5% (-140bp); insurance & claims cost of services 2.1% vs 1.1% and SG&A 1.3% vs 0.7%. 2026 outlook CUT on Q3 call (22-Oct-2026): organic 4-6% (from ~6% at Q2), incremental margin slightly positive to 10%; acquisitions 2-3% unchanged; no 2027 view until Q4; long-term algorithm 7-8% organic retained (TARGET). Price: 'customer response to our recent price increase has been favorable', positive price-cost expected; numeric price vs volume split not disclosed.

geography.note: 10-K note: United States $3,491.3m, Other countries $269.7m of $3,761.1m -> US 92.8%, other 7.2% (derived from FACT). Company-owned operations outside US: Canada, Australia, UK, Singapore plus international franchises; split of the 7.2% not disclosed (North America therefore >=92.8% but exact null). No China operations.

claim_checks.finding: FY2024 organic was 7.9% (not 7.4%) per Q4-24 release reconciliation. FY23 8.2% and FY25 6.9% confirmed. Deceleration: 8.2 -> 7.9 -> 6.9 -> 5.5 (9M-26) -> 4.4 (Q3-26).

Confirmed by CFO on Q3-26 call (PitchBook transcript): 'We now expect organic growth of 4 to 6% for the year' vs ~6% outlook at Q2; driven by weaker residential leads (AI-driven search shift) and staffing constraints. Not in the earnings release text itself.
No recurring-revenue % in releases/10-K excerpts read; company describes 'recurring customer relationships' qualitatively. Leave null.
